title: International mark application · Quick guide
slide_intent: Check four conditions for a recognizable international signature. Poor reproduction, crowding and a busy background each change how easily a reader can identify the sender.
strategic_value: A compact placement guide can give Special Olympics teams a common way to check the international mark across print and office production.
demonstration: Four numbered rows compare file formats, right-corner placements, clearance around the international lockup, and examples of one- and two-color marks on different grounds.
practical_value: Select official artwork, choose the corner with equal offsets, reserve the height of the O in Olympics as clearance and check contrast on the actual ground.

content_islands.name: Artwork and placement
content_islands.spec: Set the first two numbered instructions beside file icons and page diagrams. Show the EPS and PNG use cases and indicate top-right or bottom-right positions.

content_islands.name: Clearance diagram
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the international lockup at right in the third row. Indicate its surrounding free space with a bounding diagram.

content_islands.name: Ground comparison
content_islands.spec: Finish with two-color and single-color columns. Put accepted treatments above crossed examples so the reader can compare backgrounds directly.
